title: Humpback whale distinct population segments, recovery status

source.name: Endangered Species Act status review of the humpback whale
source.publisher: NOAA Fisheries / National Marine Fisheries Service

notes: NOAA's 2016 review split humpback whales into 14 distinct population segments worldwide. 10 were found to be healthy enough to be removed from the endangered species list; 4 remain listed as endangered or threatened.
